item.title: Collecting L-band Satellite Signals
item.description: In the past, I have captured signals at 137.1 MHz from the NOAA 19 weather satellite using a discone antenna without any pointing. It was exciting to see weather images appear on the computer monitor after processing the signals. At the time, I planned to find a way to set up a tracking capability so I could track the satellites while pointing a higher gain antenna at them to get better signal-to-noise ratios (SNR) and longer collection time. Well, I have finally put together a system that can do this for L-band and UHF frequencies. A system adequate for x-band is in the works.
